meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 装上后，当你说要分子对接时，Claude 会用 DiffDock 把配体小分子对接到蛋白上，输出多个预测结合姿势及置信度分数，支持单个、批量或虚拟筛选，并会解释置信度含义。
howto.when: 当你提出“预测结合姿势”“做分子对接”“虚拟筛选化合物库”等要求，并提供蛋白结构/序列与配体文件或 SMILES 时触发。

say.text: 用这个蛋白PDB和配体SMILES跑一次对接
say.note: 生成排名靠前的结合姿势和置信度

say.text: 对batch_input.csv里的复合物批量对接
say.note: 逐复合物输出姿势文件

say.text: 分析results目录里的置信度并导出CSV

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask for molecular docking, Claude uses DiffDock to dock small-molecule ligands to proteins, producing multiple predicted binding poses with confidence scores for single, batch, or virtual-screening runs, and interprets confidence values.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to predict a binding pose, run docking, or screen a compound library, and provide a protein structure/sequence plus ligand file or SMILES.

say_en.text: Run one docking with this protein PDB and ligand SMILES.
Analyze confidence in the results dir and export a CSV.
say_en.note: Produces summary statistics and top list.
